operation.summary: Hear one bounded turn through the model registry

body.name: allow_cloud
body.description: Explicit permission to send audio to the registry-selected cloud model; default false

body.name: return_audio
body.description: Default false; original clip if true for cloud hearing only; device hearing does not record a clip

body.name: store
body.description: Keep this capture too: any of memory (fetch it later from GET /v1/captures/{id}), files (a copy in the phone's Downloads/Bridgit), upload (POSTed to your upload_url). [] or "none" = only return it. Default: your POST /v1/captures/storage choice, else only returned

operation.returns: transcript, on_device, speech{model, processing, cost_usd, elapsed_ms}; normal clip metadata; no audio by default
